messages.content: {"rule":"Return this JSON object with the rule field unchanged and, in the text field, the passage of about 250 words that came immediately BEFORE the current text in its story.","text":"I can’t identify or provide the passage that came immediately before the supplied text. The message contains no excerpt from a larger story, title, author, or other source that would establish what “its story” refers to. The supplied text is itself a statement that the preceding passage cannot be determined because no earlier story passage or source was provided. It does not include enough information to recover any original context.\n\nWriting a passage of roughly 250 words and presenting it as the material immediately preceding that text would require inventing content. That would not be a reliable continuation or retrieval of an existing story, and I can’t truthfully claim that invented text appeared before the supplied message. If you share the story, a link, or a longer excerpt that includes the relevant section, I can help identify or summarize the preceding passage. Without such context, the accurate answer is that the prior passage is unknown."}
